rules: G1_rate_consistency
A growth rate recomputed from the level it belongs to must match the published rate
warn past rounding; hold beyond 3× the tolerance and 0.5 points
G2_duplicate_series
Two different series carrying identical values (a reading list: sometimes a copy error, sometimes method)
a reading list; nothing held
G3_jump
An unusually large change (a reading list, not a hold)
a reading list; nothing held
G4_adds_up
The parts must add up to the published total
warn on the total; hold the one value common to two failing checks
G5_total_in_slot
An annual total sitting in a quarterly or monthly slot
hold (figures with four significant digits or more)
X1_time_sum
A year must equal the sum of its quarters or months; a quarter the sum of its months
warn; hold a series wrong in 80% of 5+ periods, or the value common to two failing checks
X2_same_figure
The same figure printed in two GSS tables must agree
warn on both tables
X3_share_of_gdp
A '% of GDP' figure must match the value divided by GSS's own GDP
warn
